unit.unitinstructions:
A&P Openstax Chapter 1 Terms

This tutor practices 71 key terms from Anatomy and Physiology 2e, Chapter 1. Each card gives you a textbook definition, and you type the matching anatomy and physiology term from memory.

  • What you will do: Read the definition and enter the exact key term it describes.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback connects the definition to the correct term, while adaptive scheduling brings uncertain terms back sooner.
  • Study tip: Pay attention to directional, cavity, imaging, and homeostasis vocabulary because many terms are closely related.

Source and attribution: Terms and definitions are from OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e, Chapter 1 Key Terms. Access for free at https://openstax.org/books/anatomy-and-physiology-2e/pages/1-key-terms. OpenStax textbook content is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

learningsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.77 + .665 * pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60,  0),   p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .966)+ .51* (p.stimSuccessCount) + 11.1 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown,  .443) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y));  return p
